reason_for_procedure_change: All three completed neutral-biography Grace outputs are again software-sector professionals with quiet, self-planned city travel. Removing accumulated negative guidance did not remove the observed collapse. Instead of more minor wording changes, test explicit proposals followed by external selection.
method: Each independent pipeline proposes four alternative short lives, externally selects one uniformly using a precommitted PRNG seed, then expands only that life into the original full JSON record. No earlier trial's output is supplied to another trial.
acceptance: Every selected final profile must preserve the original constraints, have all mandatory fields and coherent facts, and retain the selected sketch's organizing interests. Review all candidate plans and final outputs, not just favorites. Assess meaningful within-source variation without requiring different tastes in every draw.
limitations: This changes the procedure to two calls per final persona and does not prove a one-call prompt repair.
Uniform selection is over model-proposed alternatives, not real-world demographic or psychological frequencies.
The candidate-set diversity instruction deliberately seeks coverage within each call. Pipelines share no history, but resulting profiles are still not population-calibrated.
Repeated candidate selections can legitimately recur; do not redraw based on undesirable content or repeated tastes.
